info.name: AgroLoop Circular Economy Platform API
info.description:
# AgroLoop Circular Economy Platform API

Authoritative REST API collection for AgroLoop covering:
- **Authentication & Sessions** (`/api/v1/auth/*`)
- **System Discovery & Meta** (`/api/v1/meta`, `/api/v1/health`)
- **Marketplace & Products** (`/api/v1/marketplace/*`)
- **Orders & Status Lifecycle** (`/api/v1/orders/*`)
- **Household Operations** (`/api/v1/household/*`)
- **Farmer Fulfillment & Routes** (`/api/v1/farmer/*`)
- **Handshake & Verification** (`/api/v1/pickups/*`)
- **Reviews & Reputation** (`/api/v1/reviews/*`)
- **Media Storage Engine** (`/api/v1/media/*`)
- **Real-Time Notifications** (`/api/v1/notifications/*`)
- **Admin Governance** (`/api/v1/admin/*`)

## Authentication Modes:
1. **Fixed Dev API Key (Zero Setup)**: Header `X-API-Key: {{apiKey}}` (defaults to `agroloop-dev-key`). Works immediately for local development and carrier simulation.
2. **Standard JWT**: Header `Authorization: Bearer {{bearerToken}}`. Automatically saved into environment upon running `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.
